title: Flatten Nested Sum
statement: Read n lines, each a space-separated list of integers (a jagged 2D list). Print the sum of every number across all lines.
starter_code:
n = int(input())
total = 0
for _ in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    total += sum(row)
print(total)
hints: This one's already fully written as a reference - study the pattern for reading n rows
